title: The sector box Z_s is open and the polar map (|x|, arctan(⟨x,e⟩/⟨x,a⟩)) is C¹ on the half-space ⟨x,a⟩ > 0
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection π := Q.starProjection, a, e ∈ ℝ^P and s ∈ ℝ. Put f(x) := arctan(⟨x,e⟩/⟨x,a⟩) (real division, t/0 = 0), F̃(x) := (|x|, f(x)) ∈ ℝ × ℝ, Ω := {x : ⟨x,a⟩ > 0} and Z_s := {x : ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s, |f(x)| < s, |x − πx| < s|x|}. Then Z_s is open and F̃ is C¹ on Ω (ContDiffOn ℝ 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), IsOpen {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : Euclid P => (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a))) {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a}
